negative_control.result: Expected failure before fix: [21600.0, 21600.0] != [60, 21600]; first retry waited six hours.

scope: Calendar background refresh retry and response logging only; no HTTP wire model or frontend changes.
limits: Real upstream internal failure was not reproduced deliberately. The recorded HTTP-200/code-7 response is injected only in isolated local tests.
The operational market route has a TTL cache. Deployment verification must use the calendar refresher response log itself.
reuse: Source bytes match the passing final full suite. Follow-up validation documentation is excluded from the input fingerprint and does not change code.
